item.title: Phoenix Police officer kills homeowner who disarmed home invasion suspect
item.description: New details from the Phoenix Police Department reveal an officer fatally shot a man who had disarmed a home invasion suspect before police arrived at a home near 75th Avenue and Lower Buckeye Road on Jan. 26."Multiple 9-1-1 calls came in regarding a man shooting at a house. The first call indicated a man was shooting a neighbor’s home. In the background dispatch can hear the shots being fired," Phoenix Police said.In one call, Phoenix Police says a caller stated, "Somebody shot one of my kids."
